div.div: 8 ابترد He washed himself with cold water: (S:) and likewise, (S,) or ابتردالمَآءَ, (K,) he drank water to cool his liver: (S, K:) or the latter signifies he poured the water cold upon himself, (M, K,) meaning, upon his head: (M:) and بِالْمَاءِ ↓ تبرّد , (T, A,) and ابترد, (A,) he washed himself with water, or with the water. (T.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
